catalogModel.title: Scelte fisse
catalogModel.lead: Queste sono le scelte fisse del tuo fornitore. La pianificazione settimanale le utilizza quando pubblichi il pranzo per giorni specifici.
catalogModel.weekPlanHint: Le modifiche si applicano dalla prossima pubblicazione settimanale. Il piatto caldo del giorno e l'upgrade Enterprise sono pianificati nella pianificazione settimanale.

translationsPage.title: Traduzioni menu
translationsPage.lead: Approva e gestisci testi tradotti per {providerName}. Questo non cambia ancora ciò che vedono i dipendenti.

translations.introApproved: Only approved translations are shown to employees. Draft, suggested and rejected rows are never shown to employees.
translations.introPartialCoverage: Partial coverage is normal. Missing or stale hash falls back to the provider's original text — this does not change order keys, package or price for employees.
translations.introSourceRefs: Source refs: meal = item.key, category = category slug (e.g. paasmurt, salat), allergen = normalized token.
translations.introSources: Sources come from catalog and active menu window (published menuDay rows). Hot meal/menu_day sources appear when present in the active menu window.
translations.noSources: No sources found in catalog yet.
translations.missingCount: {count} sources missing a row for at least one target language.
translations.staleWarning: {count} sources have hash mismatch — employees see original text until the row is approved again.
translations.createLead: Create a manual row with source ref and original text, or use «Create draft» from the source list above.

translations.emptyList: No translation rows yet. Create a row manually, or wait until import from menu sources is available.
